# Planks

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing) · [Uses](#used-to-make)

<a href="Item-planks.md" title="Planks"><img src="icons/20.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Planks"></a>

Processed wood for early tools, sticks, stations and building. One log makes four planks.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Furnace fuel duration | 15 seconds |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## Furnace fuel

One item supplies **15 seconds** of burning fuel. Use it in a [Furnace](Item-furnace.md) for smelting or cooking.
